title: Staff accountant moving toward FP&A financial analyst
description: A 4-year staff accountant (Excel modeling, QuickBooks, NetSuite, GAAP, basic SQL) targeting FP&A financial analyst roles, evaluated against 8 postings: one strong FP&A match with planning-tool and SQL gaps, two more finance-analysis matches, one marginal BI analyst role, and four unrelated distractors.
rationale: This is a non-tech finance scenario: relevance hinges on accounting/FP&A domain vocabulary rather than a software stack. Gap target j1 is a grade-3 FP&A analyst role the resume can credibly land — it overlaps heavily on Excel financial modeling, GAAP, variance analysis, and NetSuite — but demands forecasting platforms (Anaplan or Adaptive Planning) the resume has never touched and advanced SQL where the resume only has basics, giving clean annotated gaps. j2 and j3 are neighboring FP&A/financial-analysis roles (j3 graded 2, not 3, because it wants 5+ years against the resume's 4). j4 probes the graded boundary: a BI analyst role with real SQL/Excel/stakeholder overlap but a different job family and core stack (Tableau, Snowflake, dbt). j5-j8 are unrelated job-board noise.

resume.summary: Staff accountant with 4 years across month-end close, GAAP reporting, and budget-vs-actual analysis for a mid-market food manufacturer. Built Excel models and Power Query pipelines that cut close time by a third, and now targeting an FP&A financial analyst seat. Comfortable pulling my own GL data with basic SQL.

jobs.raw_text:
Financial Analyst, FP&A — Meridian Outdoor Co. (Hybrid, Columbus OH)

Meridian Outdoor Co. designs camping gear sold through 900 retail doors. Our FP&A team of four is hiring an analyst to own forecasting for the wholesale channel.

What you will do:
- Build and maintain driver-based revenue and expense forecast models
- Prepare monthly variance analysis comparing actuals to budget and forecast for leadership
- Partner with department owners through the annual budgeting cycle
- Automate recurring management reporting packages

Requirements: advanced Excel financial modeling, GAAP fluency, variance analysis, hands-on experience with Anaplan or Adaptive Planning, and advanced SQL (multi-table joins, window functions). 3+ years in accounting or FP&A and at least one full annual budget cycle supported end to end. Bachelor's in Finance, Accounting, or related. Nice to have: Power BI, NetSuite, Python for data analysis. CPA or CFA progress is a plus.

FP&A Analyst — Brightpath Logistics (Remote, US)

Brightpath Logistics runs regional freight brokerage across the Midwest. Finance is a lean team and the FP&A Analyst touches everything from forecasting to board reporting support.

You will support monthly forecast updates and scenario models, publish budget-vs-actual reporting for operations leaders, and maintain headcount and opex planning files alongside the finance manager.

What we look for: strong Excel modeling, budgeting and forecasting fundamentals, sharp variance analysis, and fluency with the three financial statements. 2+ years in FP&A, accounting, or corporate finance. Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting. Bonus points for Adaptive Planning or SQL exposure — neither is required, we will train the right person.

Senior Financial Analyst — Cobalt Medical Devices (Hybrid, Cleveland OH)

Cobalt Medical Devices manufactures surgical instruments in two Ohio plants. We are hiring a Senior Financial Analyst to own executive reporting.

Responsibilities: own the consolidated monthly reporting package for the executive team, build product-line profitability models, and lead the quarterly reforecast with plant controllers.

Requirements: advanced Excel, GAAP reporting, forecasting experience, and comfort with cost accounting concepts (standard costs, absorption). 5+ years in financial analysis or accounting. Bachelor's in Accounting or Finance; CPA preferred. Nice to have: Hyperion or Anaplan, Power BI. Relocation assistance available for the right candidate.

Business Intelligence Analyst — Trellis Retail Group (Remote, US)

Trellis Retail Group operates 140 home-goods stores and a growing e-commerce arm. The analytics team is hiring a BI Analyst to serve merchandising.

Requirements: strong SQL, Tableau, dimensional data modeling, and clear stakeholder communication. 3+ years in analytics or BI. Bonus: Python, dbt. We ship weekly and measure everything — you will present findings directly to category directors.
